name: cache-compact
description: Compacts an idle session just before its prompt cache expires.

marginSeconds.title: Margin (seconds)
marginSeconds.description: Compact this many seconds before the TTL ends. Must be less than the TTL; otherwise 30 (or a tenth of the TTL).

minTokens.title: Minimum context (tokens)
minTokens.description: Do not compact when the context is smaller than this. Must be more than 0; otherwise 40000.
